column1: # ZAP baseline scan rule overrides for this app.
# Only add an IGNORE here for a rule that has been manually verified as a false
# positive for this app, with the reasoning recorded below. Never blanket-ignore
# a rule to make the job pass without investigating the alert first.
# 10015: "Re-examine Cache-control Directives" — informational, fires on static
# hashed assets we intentionally cache long-term (immutable, content-hashed
# filenames from the Vite build); caching itself is not a vulnerability here.
